title: dreamt i was trapped in the polish/russian underground subway station labyrinth, found a store similar to walmart.
content: i was going from small hallway to small hallway underground looking for a way to the surface, it was kinda depressing, eventually found this big hallway with a big bright walmart type store at the end. didnt go over there but i knew in my heart i had seen it before (probably in previous dreams that i had forgotten). went down a rising side-hallway and found a small sealed window to the surface. behind it there was some guy gardening or somthin. i knocked on the window to get his attention. he saw me and came over and opened up the window, then opened up the whole wall and i was finally able to climb to the surface. it was then i realized that this "random guy" was the russian doppelganger of my old friend from elementary school. then my ACTUAL old friend from elementary school showed up and was like "if youre really my doppelganger, what are my 2 traits?" russian friend said "forcing, and forcings." old elementary school friend was like "wow u really are my doppelganger!!!!" then i woke up.
